The s2 gap of about 2.2 s between events is the only visible slack. Provider also flags 5.58 to 9.94 s as a slightly long hold. The closing tail after 42.2 s to 44 s then 5 s credits is acceptable. I saw no rushed handoff in the stills, but s3 events 2 and 3 are very short (about 0.5 s each). Not confirmed in motion.
attention_review.comprehension_observed: From stills one viewing yields: a UTMB clinician asks OpenEvidence a question, the answer comes with sources, announced September 22nd and live since March, more than half of clinicians use it per UTMB, and accuracy and patient care aren't in the release. Source limit is clear in s6 and s8. Mild density in s6 and s8 with several tags.
